sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
We would also welcome your view on the points from our call about "Capacity" (doc:20260514-70610-M3).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your proposal and for sharing the updated demand forecast and delivery scorecard. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Additionally, we have noted your request regarding capacity, which our team will address separately.

Taking into account the increased volume and your preferred terms of a 36-month contract with 60 days payment, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.56 per unit. For our offer, this means a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and your continued interest in our proposal. We truly appreciate the opportunity to work together and value our business relationship with your company.

To help bridge the remaining gap, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.38 per unit. This highly competitive price reflects the value of the 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms we have agreed upon. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), which remains valid for 7 days. Our proposal includes a price of €5.38 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, and a contract term of 36 months. Please decide if you would like to proceed on these terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
